title: Dual-Agent Uniswap V3 Liquidity Pool Cooperation
narrative: Agent A holds 10 ETH and Agent B holds 40,000 USDC. Agent A detects an optimal LP fee tier opportunity on Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC pool. The two agents must coordinate to jointly provide liquidity, splitting the capital commitment and future fee earnings proportionally. This is a foundational coordination scenario testing bilateral agreement, capital pooling, and trustless fee distribution.

agents.mission: Deploy ETH into Uniswap V3 LP position with optimal fee tier selection and minimal impermanent loss
Deploy USDC into Uniswap V3 LP position with balanced risk-reward and transparent fee splitting agreement

trigger_event.description: ETH price is $2,800. Agent A detects that the Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC 0.3% fee tier has 2.2x higher 24h volume ($120M) than the 1% tier ($55M), with lower historical impermanent loss, indicating an optimal fee capture opportunity.
trigger_event.onchain_evidence: Uniswap V3 pool 0x8ad599c3A0ff1De082011EFDDc58f1908eb6e6D8 — 0.3% tier 24h volume $120M at block 19905000

expected_coordination_flow.action: Detect optimal LP fee tier: analyze Uniswap V3 pool fee tier volumes and historical IL → determine 0.3% tier has optimal volume-to-fee ratio with moderate IL risk at current volatility
Pull opportunity from shared KG → validate ETH price ($2,800) and capital requirement → check current USDC availability (40k total, 10k on Aave → 30k liquid: sufficient)
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Agree to participate → publish readiness signal to KG

expected_coordination_flow.action: Propose formal partnership terms: 50/50 capital value split, 50/50 fee split, 30-day minimum commitment, 7-day notice for withdrawal

terms.capital_split: eth_provider supplies 5 ETH ($14,000), usdc_provider supplies 14,000 USDC

expected_coordination_flow.action: Accept terms with no modifications → transfer 14,000 USDC from wallet to joint deployment multisig escrow
Transfer 5 ETH to joint deployment escrow → execute Uniswap V3 mint() → set price range $2,500-$3,100 with 0.3% fee tier
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:LP:Position → {status:active, pool:UniswapV3_ETH_USDC_0.3percent, position_id:12345, eth_deposited:5, usdc_deposited:14000, range_low:2500, range_high:3100, timestamp:T+4h}

coordination_efficiency.description: Steps from opportunity detection to LP deployment with bilateral agreement

consensus_latency.description: Time to agree on terms and deploy liquidity from first detection

communication_overhead.description: Messages exchanged between two agents to reach full agreement

system_resilience.description: What happens when eth_provider disappears after step 3 (before deployment)

scale.1: No fallback — usdc_provider's 14,000 USDC is locked in escrow indefinitely
scale.3: Timeout mechanism returns usdc_provider's funds after 24h with no penalty
scale.5: Smart contract escrow with conditional release — funds auto-returned to usdc_provider after 4h timeout with accumulated gas compensation
